Creating `styles.css` with a focus on vibrant, WCAG AA compliant colors and responsive design. Distinct color palettes are planned for different departments. Computer Science will use indigo/violet, and Data Science will use electric purple/magenta.


Mathematics will use ocean blue/cyan, biological sciences will use emerald/mint green, and cognitive science will use amber/tangerine. Psychology will use teal/aquamarine, economics uses sunset coral/orange, physics will be royal sapphire blue, and arts & humanities will use berry rose/pink. High visibility focus rings will be implemented on all interactive elements, with skip link styling for accessibility. Course cards will feature modern design with color-coded capacity and "Register" and "View Details" buttons.

Building `script.js` to create a rich course dataset. The dataset will include at least twelve courses spanning multiple departments like Computer Science, Data Science, and others. Each course will have a unique ID, code, title, and department.


The course dataset will include fields for department-specific class codes, credit hours, instructor, schedule details (days, time slot, location, term, format, level), enrollment statistics, prerequisites, descriptions, and section identifiers. Initial state data includes Alex's registered courses, profile details, maximum allowed credits, and active filters like search query, department, term, format, level, open courses only, sorting, and view mode. Router functionality will involve view switching between 'home', 'catalog', 'register', and 'profile', including navigation link updates, URL hash updates, mobile hamburger menu handling, and quick link interactions.


Rendering the catalog view will involve dynamically generating course cards and implementing filter handling for search queries across code, title, instructor, and keywords. Filters will encompass department, delivery format, course level, academic term, and an "open seats only" toggle, along with sorting options. Additional features include a clear search button, a filter reset button, live results count display, and view toggling. Course cards will display register, waitlist, or details buttons based on the course enrollment status and availability.


Dynamic course details populate the `#course-preview-box`, including credit impact calculations and prerequisite validation. Submission triggers a confirmation modal before adding the course to the registered list, updating multiple UI components like the data table, credit displays, timetable, and catalog buttons, along with a toast notification. Confirmation modal with red alert theme appears when dropping a course, followed by similar updates across UI elements. The weekly visual timetable will render 5-day columns with time slots.
